newsitem.title: USA: Atmos, United Cities merger approved.
newsitem.headline: Atmos, United Cities merger approved.

text.p: Shareholders of Atmos Energy Corp and United Cities Gas Co on Tuesday agreed to their proposed merger in a one-for-one stock transaction, company officials said.
Atmos Chairman Charles Vaughan said the merger received the support of about 85 percent of Atmos shareholders at a special meeting in Dallas.
United Cities shareholders approved its merger into Atmos with 72 percent support at a meeting in Brentwood, Tenn.

Under the terms of the merger between the two natural gas companies, which Atmos company officials expect to complete in early 1997, one share of Atmos will be exchanged for each share of United Cities.
Atmos shareholders also agreed to issue about 13.35 million new shares of common stock in order to carry out the merger deal. Atmos currently has about 15.6 million shares.
Atmos shares were down 1/8 at 22-7/8 on the New York Stock Exchange while United Cities shares were unchanged at 21-1/2 on the Nasdaq National Market.
